features.name: South terminal gateway candidate and separate pool barrier
features.observed: The public lane photos show a distant shallow terminal gateway/frame with circular warning marker beyond. Private middle-pool photos09/12 show a closer open iron-gated approach, shaped white head, notices and a separate glass pool barrier/lifering beyond. Matching façade, palm and pool-planting context supports a candidate association; the glass seen at distance must not automatically become the gate material.
features.unknowns: The two private closer views face towards the pool, not back into Elena. Exact identity/world registration, opposite-end lane view, operational state over time, threshold level and shared/public access remain unresolved. No roofed tunnel is established by this shallow gateway.

features.name: Cervantes/Elena ramp and three-riser stair side by side
features.observed: Three separate white riser faces with red treads lie beside a continuous sloping tiled strip. The flight occupies one side only. Rounded lawn kerb and a separate low planter wall constrain opposite edges; a full-width drainage grate crosses the foot.
features.unknowns: Rise, tread depth, ramp gradient, transverse slope and player clearance must be measured; none is established by nominal route width.
